Sunday is the first Sunday of the year. It is also the first Saturday after Easter Sunday. It is not exactly a weekend, but it is really just a few days before Easter Sunday. It was originally called Easter Monday because people didn’t have to eat eggs and meat all night until the day before Easter. The date is usually used in New Testament writings for that month (Acts 14).
The first Sunday of the week begins on Sunday with Easter Sunday, which is supposed to be the day before Easter Sunday. This is when Jesus Christ appeared on the cross as he was going to the tomb (Luke 19:36-42). As we are told in Matthew 12:43 and Mark 12:10, this is the time Jesus took his disciples out of the tomb.

She has also conducted education outreach activities for environmental nonprofits including Eco-Theaters, The Canoe Club, or Community Environmental Network.
On the island of Borneo, Dr. Kowalski helps build a database of marine biodiversity by collecting fish samples from 200 years ago. This data helps us understand how natural ecosystems work, what species and animals are on the planet, and why they're important. In her book, "An Introduction to Oceanography," Dr. Kowalski describes the different ways marine ecosystems function and uses that information to inform decisions and decision-making in society.
In addition to researching marine life in the ocean, Dr. Kowalski has led many other projects focusing on the environment.
